title: Refactor workflows need server-side handles for isolate continuity
wanted_capability: A server-side refactor session or prepare handle that pins project_dir, source hashes, selected items, generated plans, preflight results, and apply eligibility across fresh JS isolates without copying giant plan JSON through model context or exec KV.
fallback_used: Stored intermediate catalog/status data in exec store/load and relied on the model to remember the pipeline.
notes: Exec store/load is session-local and useful, but the refactor daemon should own refactor state when plans cross isolate/tool turns.
resolution_note: Moot and directionally contradicted. No server-side refactor session handle exists (plan_path is the closest). The gap asks for MORE daemon-side state (pinning project_dir/hashes/plans/preflight across JS isolates), which is the opposite of the ratified end state: decision af3c4783 — "Refactor tooling end state is harness-native, zero daemon reach-back" (+ b8dc263d; bbox-refactor/AGENTS.md). Refactor workflows run inside the bro-harness cell choke point with facts/algebra/apply as pure substrate functions; they do not pin daemon-side session state. Resolving acknowledged rather than building the contradicted surface.
